rationale: Y has a much more specific hero product visual (policy summary with flood illustration, risk gauge, premium savings) and feature cards with distinct mini-UIs, plus a warm teal/espresso palette that feels deliberate. X has strong serif typography and a pleasant palette, but its feature illustrations are generic icon tiles and the hero card is smaller and less convincing, so it reads as the more template-like of the two. Y has minor flaws, such as the '1 in 75 yr' label overlapping the house art.
